title: Resolution urging Albany to fund full vaccine costs for insurers
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Assembly to pass A.3839 and the Governor to sign S.5852/A.3839, which would require insurers to reimburse healthcare practices for the full direct and indirect costs of administering vaccines, including acquisition, storage, shipping and administration expenses. It cites data showing vaccine costs are a major financial burden on pediatric and family medicine practices, with some practices halting vaccine purchases, and notes declining flu vaccination rates among New York City children.
